status: same-input comparison after v10 outcomes were known; previously inspected patients, no independent confirmation
inputs: Exactly raw T, original uHNDI and six v10 paired-component local window/power scores. No quality-control features, missingness, clinical metadata or diagnosis proxies. Reuse all109 retained patients, exact original inner/outer split IDs, five seeds.
selection: Mean original three inner-fold AUC; first listed candidate on ties within1e-12; refit chosen configuration only on outer training patients

etmc.implementation: Explicit vector adaptation of journal pseudo-view ETMC, four linear Softplus2-class heads and concatenation pseudo-view, DS/Dirichlet and annealed KL; not RGB-D backbone replication

roboss.implementation: Paper Eq8/12/19 objective, Gaussian full-training kernel, L-BFGS zero initialization adaptation, not official NAG solver

tabpfn.implementation: Official local package and Nature-v2 checkpoint, no network inference API; fixed configuration, same training-only labels
tabpfn.exposure_limit: Upstream pretraining/development exposure cannot be independently exhaustively audited

adapter_origin: Exact source snapshot from codex/unified-three-cohort-v2:src/public_validation/recent_comparators.py, SHA256 6e138c4520c04b76c87768b00e6fb10cbf60a3d426d2a43cec0e6c8c7f8549d4. Previous outputs are not reused as predictions.
environment: Isolated .local_deps scikit-learn1.6.1 and tabpfn2.0.9 imported before any sklearn module; SCIPY_ARRAY_API=1 before imports. Global dependencies are untouched. Refit same-input classical models under this environment and require v10 primary predictions to replay within1e-10. Record package code and checkpoint hashes.
primary_grid: Unchanged v10 menu and functional algorithm,25 candidates; all earlier sources/protocols/results protected bytewise
metric: Mean outer-fold AUC, all five seeds, equal cohort macro. No best-method/seed selection or clinical superiority claim
limitations: These are relevant general machine-learning comparators, not three validated DoC bedside algorithms. Two are disclosed adaptations and have limited tuning menus; three strict full-paper reproductions remain unproven. EEG methods requiring unreleased raw multichannel/trial inputs cannot be fabricated for all cohorts. Method publication prestige does not establish performance.
reporting: All weak and strong outcomes retained, all selected parameters and patient IDs recorded. If a real dependency/model failure occurs, retain precise error rather than proxy scores; resume only completed fingerprint-matching cohort artifacts.
